methodik.heading: Methodology
methodik.intro: How we work: study selection, source standards, how we handle conflicts of interest, and what the AI personas are about. This page is the long-form version of the rules every article is built on.
methodik.section.selection.heading: How we select and evaluate studies
methodik.section.selection.body: We prefer peer-reviewed studies with a DOI or PubMed ID. Validation studies tested against a recognized reference method (e.g. polysomnography for sleep stages) carry more weight than uncontrolled observations or manufacturer claims alone. Before including a study we check: how large was the sample? Was there a control group? Who funded it, and is there a visible conflict of interest? Has it been independently replicated, or does only a single paper exist so far? We do not treat manufacturer-funded studies as equivalent to independent research — they are explicitly labeled as manufacturer data in the source list, not as peer-reviewed.
methodik.section.sources.heading: Source standards
methodik.section.sources.body: Every factual claim needs a source in the article's frontmatter. Peer-reviewed sources require a DOI or PubMed ID — without one, an article cannot technically be published (our content schema enforces this at build time). Acceptable source types are peer-reviewed studies, preprints (labeled as such), manufacturer documentation (labeled as such), and institutional sources such as the AASM, WHO, or equivalent bodies. Not acceptable as a sole source: other blog posts, pure marketing pages, or unsupported claims like "studies show..." without a concrete reference. We never copy figures from studies — charts are redrawn from the underlying values and always carry an "own illustration" note plus a source citation.
methodik.section.conflicts.heading: Conflicts of interest and affiliate links
methodik.section.conflicts.body: Affiliate links are always labeled as advertising right at the link, never only as a general disclosure at the top of the article. An article with at least one affiliate link is flagged accordingly in its frontmatter. Commercialization doesn't change the source requirement: an accuracy or effectiveness claim about a product needs the same evidence whether or not the article contains an affiliate link. Region-specific product links (see the region switcher) only change where the link points, not the editorial assessment of the product. Which partner programs are active is documented in /data/products.json, including commission and cookie duration.
methodik.section.ai.heading: AI labeling
methodik.section.ai.body: All AI-generated or AI-assisted text is labeled — that's a legal transparency requirement (including under the EU AI Act), not a marketing claim. The notice sits deliberately unobtrusive at the end of an article, not as a banner above it: a short, small-print sentence stating the text was created with AI assistance and reviewed editorially. We don't communicate "AI" or "free of hallucinations" as a selling point — our brand message is "evidence over marketing," not "guaranteed error-free by AI." The general AI notice at the end of an article is independent from the persona labeling in opinion blocks: the persona box says who is speaking, the footer note says the text is AI-generated.
methodik.section.personas.heading: The persona concept
methodik.section.personas.body: Ten fixed characters appear in opinion blocks and are openly labeled as AI perspectives — not real people. They're free to disagree but never required to: two personas can take different views on the same topic when that reflects the evidence or differing priorities, but disagreement is never manufactured where the evidence is clear. Some personas also carry a quality gate: each stands for a review area (study quality, practical feasibility, medical safety, beginner-level clarity) that an article in their field should be able to withstand. The quality gate is a review framing, not censorship of the other personas — and a persona's opinion never replaces the source requirement: opinion is not an excuse for an unsupported factual claim.

datenschutz.heading: Privacy policy
datenschutz.section.controller.heading: Data controller
datenschutz.section.localstorage.heading: Local storage (no cookie banner)
datenschutz.section.localstorage.body: This site uses only functional browser localStorage — for the language choice (pref:lang), the region used for product links (pref:region), the theme choice (pref:theme), and light/dark appearance (pref:mode). No tracking cookies are set and no cross-site profiles are built. Under current assessment this does not require consent under ePrivacy-style rules, which is why no cookie banner is shown.
datenschutz.section.analytics.heading: Analytics
datenschutz.section.analytics.body: No analytics software is currently in use. A cookieless, IP-anonymized analytics solution is planned; this policy will be updated before it is activated.
